package domain

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const (
	practiceValidationStudentID  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	practiceValidationInstanceID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	practiceValidationRevisionID = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	practiceValidationActionID   = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
)

func TestNormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContextAcceptsExactSafeProjection(t *testing.T) {
	input := validPracticeTeacherValidationContext()
	got, err := NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(input, validPracticeForValidation(), practiceValidationActionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, got.Available)
	require.Equal(t, "src/main.go", got.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues[0].File)
	require.Equal(t, time.UTC, got.UpdatedAt.Location())
}

func TestNewPracticeStudentContextBindsFrozenActionAndAuthoredSurface(t *testing.T) {
	practice := completePracticeContextForValidation()
	result, err := NewPracticeStudentContext(practice, practice.LearningActionID, LearningContextPracticeTask, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, practice.LearningActionID, result.LearningActionID)

	_, err = NewPracticeStudentContext(practice, "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LearningContextPracticeTask, nil)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidStudentContext)
	_, err = NewPracticeStudentContext(practice, practice.LearningActionID, LearningContextProject, nil)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidStudentContext)
}

func TestNormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContextAcceptsExplicitUnavailableShapes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []PracticeTeacherValidationContext{
		{
			Schema: PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1, TaskInstanceID: practiceValidationInstanceID,
			StudentID: practiceValidationStudentID, TaskRevisionID: practiceValidationRevisionID,
			LearningActionID: practiceValidationActionID,
		},
		func() PracticeTeacherValidationContext {
			value := validPracticeTeacherValidationContext()
			value.Available, value.Passed, value.TeacherExplanation = false, nil, nil
			return value
		}(),
	} {
		got, err := NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(input, validPracticeForValidation(), practiceValidationActionID)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.False(t, got.Available)
		require.Nil(t, got.TeacherExplanation)
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContextFailsClosedOnBindingDrift(t *testing.T) {
	tests := map[string]func(*PracticeTeacherValidationContext){
		"instance": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TaskInstanceID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
		},
		"student": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.StudentID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
		},
		"revision": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TaskRevisionID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
		},
		"action": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.LearningActionID = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
		},
	}
	for name, mutate := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := validPracticeTeacherValidationContext()
			mutate(&input)
			_, err := NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(input, validPracticeForValidation(), practiceValidationActionID)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidStudentContext)
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContextRejectsMalformedAndLeakyProjection(t *testing.T) {
	tests := map[string]func(*PracticeTeacherValidationContext){
		"available nulls":          func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { value.SubmissionID = nil },
		"unavailable explanation":  func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { value.Available = false },
		"passed mismatch":          func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { value.TeacherExplanation.Passed = true },
		"invalid workspace digest": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { digest := "raw"; value.WorkspaceDigest = &digest },
		"invalid source digest":    func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { value.TeacherExplanation.SourceDigest = "raw" },
		"nil issues":               func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) { value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues = nil },
		"too many issues": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues = make([]TeacherValidationIssue, 6)
		},
		"private absolute path": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues[0].Message = "failed at /srv/private/test.go"
		},
		"traversal": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues[0].File = "../hidden.go"
		},
		"private windows path": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues[0].Hint = `see C:\\private\\fixture.go`
		},
		"oversized explanation": func(value *PracticeTeacherValidationContext) {
			value.TeacherExplanation.BlockingIssues[0].Message = strings.Repeat("x", maximumTeacherValidationMessageRunes+1)
		},
	}
	for name, mutate := range tests {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := validPracticeTeacherValidationContext()
			mutate(&input)
			_, err := NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(input, validPracticeForValidation(), practiceValidationActionID)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidStudentContext)
		})
	}
}

func validPracticeTeacherValidationContext() PracticeTeacherValidationContext {
	submissionID := "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	workspaceDigest := "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64)
	checkedAt := time.Date(2026, 9, 5, 10, 0, 0, 123, time.FixedZone("test", 2*60*60))
	passed := false
	return PracticeTeacherValidationContext{
		Schema: PracticeTeacherValidationContextSchemaV1, Available: true,
		TaskInstanceID: practiceValidationInstanceID, StudentID: practiceValidationStudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: practiceValidationRevisionID, LearningActionID: practiceValidationActionID,
		SubmissionID: &submissionID, WorkspaceDigest: &workspaceDigest, UpdatedAt: &checkedAt, Passed: &passed,
		TeacherExplanation: &TeacherValidationExplanation{
			Schema: TeacherValidationExplanationSchemaV1, Passed: false,
			BlockingIssues: []TeacherValidationIssue{{
				Code: "REQUIRED_FILE", Message: "Create the required file.", Hint: "Add the missing file.",
				File: "src/main.go", Line: 4, Column: 2, StageID: "compile", Engine: "go.core", Severity: "error",
			}},
			SourceDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64),
		},
	}
}

func validPracticeForValidation() PracticeTaskContext {
	return PracticeTaskContext{
		TaskInstanceID: practiceValidationInstanceID, StudentID: practiceValidationStudentID,
		TaskRevisionID: practiceValidationRevisionID, LearningActionID: practiceValidationActionID,
	}
}

func completePracticeContextForValidation() PracticeTaskContext {
	return PracticeTaskContext{
		Schema: PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1, TaskInstanceID: practiceValidationInstanceID,
		StudentID: practiceValidationStudentID, TaskRevisionID: practiceValidationRevisionID,
		LearningActionID: practiceValidationActionID, Surface: "practice", Locale: "ru", Status: "ACTIVE",
		Step: PracticeTaskStepContext{ID: "implement", Title: "Implement", Objective: "Build", Status: "AVAILABLE"},
		AssistancePolicy: PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{
			Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 2, Teacher: PracticeTeacherPolicy{MayExplain: true},
		},
	}
}
